name: task-completion-guard
description: Verify task completion with observed checks and a bounded independent review for consequential changes.

interface.shortDescription: Prevent implementation tasks from ending after a partial step.
interface.longDescription: Enrolls implementation tasks in a completion audit, records observable changes and verification, and requires a fresh-context reviewer for consequential changes while keeping routine edits lightweight.
defaultPrompt: Implement this feature completely and verify the result.
Fix this bug without stopping at an intermediate step.
